name: Reference — multi-row lookup
description: Multi-row reference lookup. Returns ALL rows from a reference table that match `matchOn` (each column compared against a JSONPath). Distinct from the mutator-lookup node (which writes one column onto an upstream object). Use this when you want the rows themselves — e.g. all tax lines for a (pos, route) combo.

params.name: matchOn
params.description: Map of reference-column → JSONPath. Rows where every column equals its resolved path are returned. Omit for 'all rows'.

outputs.name: out
outputs.description: Emits the matched rows as a JSON array.
